Under Public Law 119-21 and a final rule published May 1, 2026, for periods of enrollment that begin on or after July 1, 2026, schools must reduce your annual Direct Loan limit in direct proportion to how far below full-time you are, rounded to the nearest whole percent. In an Education Department example, a student enrolled for half the full-time credits had the limit cut by 50%. It applies to term-based programs but not clock-hour or non-term programs, and Parent PLUS isn't affected. Your school's full-time definition is the baseline, so ask the aid office what your limit would be.
